# Research API (what Studio and the viewer call)

<!-- Generated by `senseai-research api-doc` from `src/senseai_research/server/contract.py`. Do not edit by hand. -->

senseai-research is the source of truth for the backend; front ends (Studio, the
viewer) reach it through their own proxy at `/api/research/*`. The full request and
response schemas are in the OpenAPI document at `/api/research/openapi.json`.

## Headers the front end's proxy sends

| Header | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `X-SenseAI-User` | The signed-in person's name. Required on every write; stored on every Approval. |
| `X-SenseAI-Proxy-Token` | Equal to `RESEARCH_PROXY_TOKEN`. Required unless the caller is on the research server's own machine. |

`GET /healthz` is open and answers only `{"ok": true}`.

## Routes

| Method | Path | |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/research/actions` | Pending changes waiting for a person. |
| POST | `/api/research/actions/{action_id}/{decision}` | Approve or reject a pending change, with the person's rationale. |
| GET | `/api/research/claims` | Claims, filtered by library path prefix or status. |
| GET | `/api/research/claims/{claim_id:path}` | One claim with its sources, passage and full revision history. |
| GET | `/api/research/conversations` | The 30 most recent conversations. |
| POST | `/api/research/conversations` | Start a conversation for the signed-in person. |
| GET | `/api/research/conversations/{cid}` | A conversation as the page shows it: messages, tool chips, cards, notes. |
| POST | `/api/research/conversations/{cid}/messages` | Send a message; the reply streams as Server-Sent Events (see Chat events). |
| GET | `/api/research/experiments/{exp_id}` | An experiment: baseline vs patched per arm, chance hit rates, progress. |
| GET | `/api/research/health` | Version, model reachability, data root, bench, profiles SHA. |
| GET | `/api/research/hypotheses` | Hypotheses and open questions. |
| GET | `/api/research/impact/{impact_id}` | A stored impact record: consumers, profile diff, reflex, world prior. |
| GET | `/api/research/passages/{passage_id}` | A passage with its context and source. |
| GET | `/api/research/proposals` | Library change proposals and their pull requests. |
| GET | `/api/research/proposals/{pid}/{what}` | Download a proposal's patch or pull-request text. |
| GET | `/api/research/settings` | Outside services and whether their keys are set (never the values). |
| POST | `/api/research/settings/{iid}/check` | Test one service's key with one small request. |
| GET | `/api/research/start` | The start screen: open questions and the least-verified values. |

## Chat events

`POST /api/research/conversations/{id}/messages` with `{"text": ..., "focus": {"claim_id" | "library_path": ...}}` answers with Server-Sent Events. Each event has a name and a JSON `data` line.

| Event | Data | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| `text_delta` | `text` | Append to the assistant's reply. |
| `thinking_summary` | `text` | A summary of the assistant's reasoning; show folded away, never as the answer. |
| `tool_call` | `id`, `name`, `label`, `kind` (read, compute or write) | Show `label` as a chip (plain language, never the raw input). |
| `tool_result_summary` | `id`, `ok`, `summary`, `refs` | Mark the chip done or failed. `refs` may hold `claim_id`, `impact_id`, `experiment_id`, `source_id`, `doi`, `section`, `text`, `context_before`, `context_after`, `pending_action_id`: open the matching panel. |
| `pending_action` | `action`: `id`, `kind`, `status`, `card` {`title`, `summary`, `rows` [{`label`, `before`, `after`}], `quote`, `diff`, `note`}, `error` | Show an Approve / Reject card with a required rationale; post it to `/api/research/actions/{action.id}/approve` (or `/reject`). |
| `job_progress` | `job_id`, `frac`, `message` (and the bench event fields) | Show experiment progress. |
| `error` | `message`, optional `code` (refusal, max_tokens, unverified_number or no_api_key), optional `numbers` | Show `message`. `unverified_number` flags numbers in the reply that no stored record supports. |
| `done` | `stop` (end_turn, pending_action, refusal, max_tokens, error or step_limit), `pending` [action ids], `usage` | The turn is over; enable the composer again. |
